_meta.definition: The process of managing stadiums and parks information, including their details, locations, and updates.

columns.name: ﻿ID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the ﻿ entity

columns.name: parkalias
columns.description: Stores unique aliases for baseball parks.
samples: The Ballpark in Arlington; Ameriquest Field in Arlington; Rangers Ballpark in Arlington

columns.name: parkkey
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for baseball parks (e.g., ALB01 for Atlanta Fulton County Stadium).

columns.name: parkname
columns.description: Stores names of up to 50 characters for baseball parks.

columns.name: city
columns.description: Stores names of cities where baseball parks are located.

columns.name: state
columns.description: Stores the state where baseball parks are located (e.g., NY, PA, CA, TX).

columns.name: country
columns.description: Stores the country where baseball parks are located (based on sample values).
